title: Leslie Kean publishes the Grusch article in The Debrief after the New York Times passes

tellings.quote:
Leslie Kane published the initial
article that prompted the whole thing
but she had to do it in the debrief
because Julian Barnes

plain: In 2023 the journalist Leslie Kean published the first article on David Grusch, a man who came forward with claims that the government was hiding UFO secrets, and that article set off everything that followed. Michels tells it, relaying what he heard, saying Kean had to publish in The Debrief, a small online news site, because Julian Barnes, a reporter at the New York Times, passed on it. It matters because it suggests the biggest paper held back the story.
